how: A commit cannot name its own hash. The FREEZE commit lands PREREG.md, screen_lib.py, launch_swap_cell.sh, adjudicate_swap_cell.py, test_swap_cell.py and selftest_fixture/ with this field reading PENDING; a SECOND, stamping commit replaces it with the freeze commit's 40-hex sha. launch_swap_cell.sh REFUSES a real chunk while it still says PENDING. --dry-run and --smoke are EXEMPT (they play only the disjoint throwaway range and spend no blindness, no band).
what_is_frozen: PREREG.md — design, bars, branch map, gates, non-inference limits, the honest power table
screen_lib.py — the shared stats/gate library, constants, branch ladder, sanity_check()
launch_swap_cell.sh — the launcher, its precondition ladder, the smoke + positive-control legs
adjudicate_swap_cell.py — the adjudicator and the READ_RULE it executes
test_swap_cell.py + selftest_fixture/ — the contract tests and the REAL-EMITTER fixtures

state_at_freeze.smoke_games_played: see DEVIATIONS/report — this build's own verification smoke, discarded seeds, not pooled
